rule.title: How the 60% rule works
rule.body: The exam has four parts: listening, reading, writing and speaking. To pass, you need at least 60% of the maximum points in each part. A strong part cannot make up for a weak one.
rule.exampleCaption: Average 76%, but the exam is not passed: speaking is below 60%.
rule.outro: That's why we show your result for each skill separately and help you fix the weakest one first.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: 4 reading and 4 listening questions, a short text (60–80 words) and a 1-minute spoken answer.
how.step2Title: See your result for each skill
how.step2Body: An approximate percentage against the 60% line: likely pass, borderline or likely fail.
how.step3Title: Find out what to fix first
how.step3Body: For writing and speaking: scores per criterion and your actual mistakes with corrections.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: No. This is an independent learning platform, not affiliated with VIAA. All tasks are original and follow the format of the exam tasks.
faq.a2: It is an approximate estimate, not an exam result. The free test is short, so it is better at showing your weakest skill than at predicting an exact score.
faq.q3: How are writing and speaking assessed?
faq.a3: An AI assesses your work against the exam criteria. We regularly compare its scores with those of a qualified teacher. In speaking we assess what you said; the pronunciation score is only approximate.
faq.q4: What language are the tasks in?
faq.a4: Tasks are always in Latvian, as in the exam. Explanations and feedback are in the language you choose: Latvian, English or Ukrainian.
faq.a5: You can start the free test without an account. To see full feedback, enter your email and we'll send you a login link. No password needed.
faq.a6: Speaking recordings are deleted automatically after 30 days. You can delete your account and all your data at any time.
faq.q7: Can I get a refund for the founding pass?
faq.a7: Yes. Until the full version launches, we refund the full amount on request: use “Withdraw from contract” in your account or email us.
faq.q8: How do I register for the exam?
faq.a8: The exam is run by a state institution, not by us. Our exam guide sums up how to register, what it costs and when results come out.
